title: Open neighbourhood of constant fibre dimension
statement: For a morphism flat and locally of finite presentation over an open U, a generic point x of a fibre component has an open neighbourhood V in X on which the local dimension of the corresponding fibres equals its value at x.

source.place: Tag 054T, fibre dimension is locally constant near a component generic point.

proof.text: Choose the constant-dimension opens V_n from the fibre dimension strata lemma. The component generic point x belongs to V_n for some n. For every y in V_n, both local fibre dimensions equal n, hence are equal by symmetry and transitivity.

proof_origin.place: Tag 054T, constant-relative-dimension opens; the equalities to n are combined explicitly in Lean by U2.

mathlib_searches.results: No existing fibrewise local-constancy theorem found.

mathlib_searches.query: flat locally finitely presented fibre dimension locally constant near generic component point

lean.statement:
theorem exists_fibre_dimension_open_of_flat_restrict
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (U : T.Opens)
    [Flat (f ∣_ U)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ∣_ U)]
    (x : X) (hx : f x ∈ U)
    (hcomponent : f.asFiber x ∈ genericPoints (f.fiber (f x))) :
    ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧
      ∀ y ∈ V, topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber y) =
        topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber x)
